summary: PowerShell utils can expose shared option specs (like API auth settings) via a uniquely named Get-<namespace.name.util>Spec function plus a function taking the AnsibleModule, and should use specific prefixed option names to avoid conflicts.
questions: How can several Windows modules share the same connection options?
How should I name a shared spec function in a PowerShell util?
Why should shared util option names have a prefix?

answer_card.title: Shared module options in PowerShell utils
answer_card.answer_md:
Convention:
- A `Get-<namespace.name.util>Spec` function (unique name) returning a spec hashtable.
- A function that takes the `AnsibleModule` via `-Module` to read the shared options.

Use specific names like `acme_password`, not `password`; clashing names or aliases can make the util unusable by modules with the same option names.
